subtitle: A bug triage note your AI fills from reports.
about: A note with a bug table sorted by severity and space for steps to reproduce each bug. Paste reports into your AI to file them, or edit the rows yourself.

ask.prompt: Set up the bug triage template in my Pinto Notes.

slides.label: File a bug
slides.you: A customer says saved cards fail at checkout.
slides.ai: Filed it as P1, with the steps to reproduce under Details.
slides.alt: Bug triage filled in, in Pinto Notes on a Mac

slides.label: Find the steps
slides.you: How do I reproduce the checkout bug?
slides.ai: Three steps, under Details: sign in with a saved card, go to checkout, pay with it.

slides.label: Use it yourself
slides.alt: Bug triage as it starts, ready to fill in
